planets.name: TOI-1259 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1259 A with a 3.48-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1259 A b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1259 A. Its orbit and size follow Veldhuis et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
